product_metadata.title: Melannco Arlington Floating Wall Shelves for Bedroom, Living Room, Nursery, Set of 2, 14-Inch, Black
features: SET OF 2 WALL SHELVES: This set includes 2 shelves, both 14 inches in size and feature an artfully bulky ledge design with a lip so items don’t slide off the edge.
CLASSIC BLACK FINISH: These shelves are made from lightweight MDF wood and feature a classic black finish that will match any home décor; use to display vases, books, and small pictures.
VERSATILE AND UNQIUE LOOK: You have the option to group the shelves together or hang separately for the perfect accent for any room; these shelves will hang flush against the wall.
UNIFORM SIZE: This set includes two shelves, both measuring 14 inches in length. Each shelf measures approximately 3.9 inches deep and 1.6 inches tall. Each shelf can hold up to 6 lbs.
EASY INSTALLATION: These wood shelves are easy to hang, included are detailed instructions with hanging template, a small level, and hardware for easy mounting; wipe with a dry cloth as needed.
description: This Set of 2 Melannco Floating Wall Shelves for Bedroom, Living Room, Bathroom, Kitchen, Nursery is perfect for displaying picture frames, vases, books, knickknacks, and more. Shelves feature a unique, black finish that complements any decor theme. Easily hang shelves using the included hardware, instructions, new screws, and anchors with a template and level. Create your own customized display by hanging shelves together or separately. Holds up to 6 pounds each. Measures 14 x 3.89 x 1.57 inches each.
